heard: It was only built to last five years. Launched on September 5, 1977, the legendary metal probe quickly became the most distant human-made object from Earth. Voyager 1 discovered active volcanoes on Jupiter's moon Io and revealed astonishingly complex structures across Saturn's rings. The durable spacecraft officially entered interstellar space in August 2012, while blazing passing along at 38,000 miles per hour. Now pushing past 15 billion miles away, harried human engineers are shutting down its remaining scientific instruments one by one. As of 2026, only two fragile science instruments remain fully operational as it sails through the frozen cosmic void. It was only built to last five years.
